Fixed in PR #8. Install modes now read from the channel subscription.yaml pins, not channels[0] — stricter than defaultChannel and matching what OLM resolves against. Also split OwnNamespace from SingleNamespace for cross-namespace OperatorGroups, and separated CHANNEL NOT FOUND from NOT IN CATALOG. Verified by reintroducing both bug classes.
